title: 第7章 一个月气血境九层第8章 败秦武三重浪圆满
slug: 满级武圣从绝世神功开始
content_zh:
“嗯？你们……”
张宿眉头一皱。
不知道这三人想干什么。
楚大川深吸了口气，随即开口道：“张师兄，我们从今往后愿意追随师兄，赴汤蹈火，在所不辞！”
张宿的目光在三人身上一一扫过。
“这都是你们三人的意思？”
“是。”
“你们为什么要追随我？虽然我击败了你们，但实力其实也没高出你们多少，在外门，比我强的弟子比比皆是。”
楚大川神情很认真，语气坚定地说道：“我们追随师兄是经过了深思熟虑的。师兄短短半个月，九影剑法居然就修炼到圆满了，这份剑法天赋，冠绝整个外门！”
“师兄此前一年时间虽然没有养出气血，但那是师兄选错了功法，那大河神功，整个归元派历史上也没多少人能练成，而师兄更换功法后，实力果然突飞猛进。”
“再加上师兄背靠苏家，拥有雄厚的财力。以后师兄肯定能成为内门弟子，到时候稍微提携我们一点，我们也有希望晋升内门。”
张宿眼神中闪过了一丝惊讶。
这个楚大川，倒并不是头脑发热，的确是经过了深思熟虑。
居然考虑得那么长远？
“我还以为你们十天时间，迟迟没有凑齐补血丸，是有意拖延，甚至在想办法对付我。”
张宿似笑非笑地说道。
楚大川摇了摇头道：“我们揪着师兄不放，一直针对师兄，对我们能有什么好处？我们还没那么愚蠢。”
“我们虽然是被归元派挑选而来，有点天赋，但类似我们这种天赋的弟子，归元派数不胜数。我们要想晋升内门，光靠这点天赋可不够，需要银子，需要人脉，需要机缘。”
“而我们如今唯一能联系到的人脉，也就只有师兄一人罢了……”
张宿没想到楚大川三人能想得这么通透。

此前他们通知王海，这点小动作，其实也是想让张宿给他们补血丸罢了。
从始至终，他们都是利益至上。
不过，张宿却觉得很有意思。
想要好处，无可厚非。
前提是，他们得有价值。
“你们，能替我做什么？”
张宿问道。
赵峰开口道：“我能替师兄跑腿，师兄有什么事，可以直接吩咐我。”
杜天则说道：“我能替师兄打听各种消息，师兄即便不出门，也能知道外门的各种消息。”
楚大川沉吟了一会儿，沉声说道：“我在剑法上有一定造诣，可以当师兄的陪练！而且，必要时候，师兄若下山，我们也能跟随师兄！”
不得不说，这三人很聪明。
知道张宿需要什么。
张宿眼睛微微一眯，心里却在衡量。
的确，这三人有一定的价值。
虽然三人功利性很强。
content_en:
"Huh? You..."
Zhang Su frowned.
I don’t know what these three people want to do.
Chu Dachuan took a deep breath, and then said: "Senior Brother Zhang, from now on we are willing to follow him, through fire and water, no matter what!"
Zhang Su's eyes swept over the three of them one by one.
"Is this what you three mean?"
"Yes."
"Why do you want to follow me? Although I defeated you, my strength is actually not much higher than yours. In the outer sect, there are many disciples who are stronger than me."
Chu Dachuan looked very serious and said in a firm tone: "We followed senior brother after careful consideration. In just half a month, senior brother has perfected the Nine Shadows Sword Technique. This talent in sword technique is the best among the entire outer sect!"
"Although senior brother didn't develop Qi and blood in the past year, it was because he chose the wrong technique. Not many people in the entire history of the Guiyuan Sect could master the Great River Divine Technique. However, after senior brother changed the technique, his strength really improved by leaps and bounds."
"In addition, senior brother is backed by the Su family and has strong financial resources. In the future, senior brother will definitely become an inner sect disciple. With a little help from us, we can also hope to be promoted to the inner sect."
A trace of surprise flashed in Zhang Su's eyes.
This Chu Dachuan is not hot-headed, but has indeed been carefully considered.
Are you thinking so far ahead?
"I thought you were delaying in gathering the blood-boosting pills for ten days because you were delaying on purpose, and you were even thinking of ways to deal with me."
Zhang Su said with a half-smile.
Chu Dachuan shook his head and said: "We hold on to our senior brother and keep targeting him. What good can it do to us? We are not that stupid."
"Although we were selected by the Guiyuan Sect and have some talents, the Guiyuan Sect has countless disciples with similar talents like ours. If we want to advance to the inner sect, this talent alone is not enough. We need money, connections, and opportunities."
"And the only person we can contact now is our senior brother..."
Zhang Su didn't expect Chu Dachuan and the others to think so clearly.
They had previously informed Wang Hai that this small move was actually to get Zhang Su to give them blood-boosting pills.
From beginning to end, their interests come first.
However, Zhang Su found it very interesting.
There is nothing wrong with wanting the benefits.
The premise is that they have to be valuable.
"What can you do for me?"
Zhang Su asked.
Zhao Feng said: "I can run errands for senior brother. If senior brother needs anything, you can directly ask me."
Du Tianze said: "I can inquire about all kinds of news for my senior brother. Even if my senior brother doesn't go out, he can still know all kinds of news about the outer sect."
Chu Dachuan pondered for a while and said in a deep voice: "I have certain attainments in swordsmanship and can be senior brother's sparring partner! Moreover, if necessary, if senior brother goes down the mountain, we can also follow him!"
I have to say that these three people are very smart.
Know what Zhang Su needs.
Zhang Su narrowed his eyes slightly, but he was weighing it in his heart.
Indeed, these three people have some value.
Although the three of them are very utilitarian.
